phases.name: runtime_gate
actions: record exact target Python/sqlite3/SQLite versions and compile options
if WAL-reset fix absent, force rollback journal + synchronous=FULL
capture baseline latency/recovery before data migration

phases.name: shadow_canonical
actions: create strict canonical transaction/epoch/record/query/effect/reentry tables
dual-observe current Frank state into shadow DB without changing read authority
hash and compare exact state after each admitted transaction
phases.rollback: drop shadow file; current source unchanged

phases.name: derived_epoch_binding
actions: add derived_from_epoch/generation/status to ClayGraph/FTS/vector projections
treat stale projections as candidate-only
rebuild and compare retrieval equivalence
phases.rollback: disable epoch-aware planner; retain old projections

phases.name: read_cutover
actions: route exact state/identity/effect queries to canonical store
route associative queries through epoch-gated derived plane
emit query receipts for every cognition-critical assembly
phases.rollback: feature-gate exact reads back to current path

phases.name: write_cutover
actions: BEGIN IMMEDIATE base_epoch/idempotency gate
seal epoch/root inside same transaction
verify crash/restart/replay and stale-writer rejection
phases.rollback: stop writer, restore last-known-good checkpoint, switch gate back

phases.name: effect_reentry_cutover
actions: bind verified provider outcome to effect_outcome receipt
admit provenance-bound reentry only after verification
test timeout-after-acceptance reconciliation
phases.rollback: degrade unresolved effects to proposal/UNKNOWN; never fabricate DONE

phases.name: physical_consolidation_optional
actions: benchmark physical consolidation and Postgres+pgvector comparator on target
promote only if correctness/recovery/resource vector dominates hybrid

hard_stop_conditions: target latency/resource regression beyond accepted bound
data_loss_policy: fail closed for consequential effects; never infer missing state
